story.value: The name platinum comes from the Spanish word platina, meaning silver.
In 1735, the Spanish astronomer Antonio de Ulloa found platinum in Peru, South America.
Pre-Columbian Indians of South America used platinum before western scientists noticed it.

uses.value: Platinum is used to make jewelry, wire, electrical contacts and laboratory vessels.
Platinum is used in catalytic converters, devices found in the exhaust systems of most cars.
Fuel cells, which combine hydrogen and oxygen to produce electricity and water, use platinum as a catalyst.
